items.title: Show HN: Send flowers from your AI agent and make your mum happy (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: Hi, I have created an MCP for AI agents to send flowers for your mum's birthday, for a great customer who just renewed his contract or what ever you can think of! I created this after working on a family AI assistant (hermo.ai) which desperately needed to trigger something tangible - like a flower delivery. You can send flowers without having to create an account to make it easy to get started. Currently you can send one type of bouquet in the USA ($100), UK(£100), Germany(€100), Switzerland and Italy. Link to the new service is here: https://preznt.net The goal of this service is to have AI agents send flowers. It's pretty simple. I have lots of ideas how to extend and order all sorts of things directly from an MCP, like chocolates, gift boxes, etc. Let me know what you think! I'd really like some feedback. Fabian Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49599559 Points: 4 # Comments: 0

items.title: Apparently CodePen 2.0 sends data to their servers as you type (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: They send all typed into editor input to codepen.dev almost immediately (you would see in 1-2 sec after you typed your secret that it appears in respective Network/Response tab) even before one saved it. I tested this with a unique marker: after typing it into index.html, CodePen ran a build with "save:false", and the marker then appeared verbatim in the HTML served from the generated "*.codepen.dev preview". Thus, if you ever entered some secrets in there by mistake consider them compromized even if you did not publish/save the pen Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49596976 Points: 78 # Comments: 37
